6586.title: Recovery after partial shell discovery
6586.rootCauseOneLine: Fallback shell discovery loses provenance, so an already-resolved command exiting 1 does not trigger recovery of its missing helper PATH.
6586.proposedFix: Track login-only fallback provenance and refresh on nonzero process exits only while discovery remains degraded; clear that state after preferred discovery succeeds.
6586.caveats: Linux component reproduction, not the original macOS/provider incident. No PR: existing package-suite failure also reproduced on unchanged production; prototype remains uncommitted and unpushed.
